preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: first line is integer n, second line is integer x.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '012\n' for c in stdin.split() if c.isdigit())
preconditions.description: First line is integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^9), second line is integer x (0 ≤ x ≤ 2).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str((x + n) % 3 if n % 2 == 1 else x)
postconditions.description: Output is the initial position of the ball (0, 1, or 2) such that after n moves (odd moves swap 0↔1, even moves swap 1↔2), the ball ends at position x. The mapping is deterministic and reversible via modulo arithmetic.
